title: Test vectors
description: One file of protocol v1's test vectors: the cases of one kind, each an input and the result the rules give it.

$schema.description: This schema's path from the file, for editors.

kind.description: What the file's cases test, which sets the fields each case has.

description.description: One or two sentences of plain text on what the file covers.

notes.description: Each flag a case may carry, mapped to a sentence on what it marks. Every flag a case carries is a key here, and every key flags some case.

tests.description: The cases, whose tcIds count up from 1.

base64url_32.description: 32 bytes as base64url without padding, in canonical form: 43 characters, the last of which leaves its two unused bits zero.

token.description: The token's text, whose UTF-8 bytes are the HMAC key.

case.description: The fields every case has, whatever its kind.

tcId.description: The case's number in its file.

comment.description: A short sentence on what the case tests.

flags.description: The notes that describe the case, by name.

result.description: Whether the rules accept the case's input.

valid.description: Matches a case whose result is valid.

hello_proof_case.description: A hello proof: the HMAC-SHA256 of the hello label, a 0x00 byte, the nonce's 32 bytes and the PID's 4 big-endian bytes, keyed by the token.

otherPid.description: The PID the proof was computed with in place of the case's. Only a case flagged RelayedProof has it.

message.description: The HMAC's input, as lowercase hex. Only a valid case has it.

proof.description: The proof: on a valid case, the one the rules give; on an invalid one, a proof computed from a mistaken input.

enrollment_proof_case.description: An enrollment proof: the HMAC-SHA256 of the enrollment label, a 0x00 byte and the challenge's 32 bytes, keyed by the token.

challenge.description: The challenge the server's hello gave.

otherChallenge.description: The challenge the proof was computed with in place of the case's. Only a case flagged OtherChallenge has it.

message.description: The HMAC's input, as lowercase hex. Only a valid case has it.

proof.description: The proof: on a valid case, the one the rules give; on an invalid one, a proof computed from a mistaken input.

header.description: The enrollment header's value: the challenge, a period, then the proof. Only a valid case has it.

template_expansion_case.description: An endpoint as a connector expands and validates it, with the values its templates take from the context.

platform.description: The client's platform, which sets the context's fields.

endpoint.description: The endpoint as given, templates included.

context.description: The values the templates expand to.

expanded.description: The endpoint after expansion. Only a valid case has it.

windows_context.description: What a Windows client's templates expand to.

userName.description: The user name GetUserNameW returns, which {user} expands to.

sessionId.description: The Remote Desktop Services session ID of the client's process, which {session} expands to.

pid.description: The client's PID, which {pid} expands to.

posix_context.description: What a POSIX client's templates expand to.

uid.description: The effective UID, which {user} expands to.

pid.description: The client's PID, which {pid} expands to.
